name: Omni Bridgeway Limited
summary: Omni Bridgeway Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides dispute and litigation finance services in Australia, the United States, Canada, Latin America, Asia, New Zealand, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers dispute funding solutions, including bankruptcy, commercial, intellectual property, investor recoveries, class/group actions, appeals, and whistleblower. The company also provides arbitration financing, judgment enforcement, and distressed asset recovery solutions It serves law firms, bankruptcy/insolvency professionals, and companies.
